headline: Nvidia's CEO scandal rattles AI markets while Anthropic eyes a $1.4T IPO, Google ships Gemini 4 Carbon, and Andhra Pradesh readies for the CII summit in Visakhapatnam.

stories.title: CII Partnership Summit opens in Visakhapatnam on Nov 12
stories.summary: Over 3,800 delegates from 59 countries are expected at the two-day summit, with more than 160 MoUs lined up. Amit Shah will address the inaugural session, and Visakhapatnam is being spruced up for the event.
stories.why_it_matters: A major investment event in Andhra Pradesh, your home region, with potential industry and jobs impact.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh Cabinet clears investment policies for AI, electronics, renewables
stories.summary: The Cabinet cleared policy frameworks to attract investment in AI, electronics and renewable energy. It also cleared a proposed ₹31,387-crore green integrated AI data centre by AM Intelligence at Amanam in Visakhapatnam district.
stories.why_it_matters: Large AI data centre and policy push in AP could shape tech jobs in the state.

stories.title: Telangana to host Bharat Summit on Nov 13-14
stories.summary: Leaders and policymakers from 70 countries are expected. Congress has invited Kharge, Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi, according to Salman Khurshid.
stories.why_it_matters: A major international political event in Telangana.

stories.title: Telangana inspects 27 ART centres in illegal oocyte collection probe
stories.summary: Notices were issued to seven hospitals. The investigation also covers women, doctors, IVF centres and intermediaries allegedly involved.
stories.why_it_matters: Significant healthcare enforcement story in Telangana.

stories.title: Telangana CM directs officials to bolster Supreme Court case on Krishna waters
stories.summary: The Chief Minister asked officials to strengthen arguments in the Supreme Court on the Krishna water dispute.
stories.why_it_matters: The river-water dispute is a long-running issue between Telugu states.

stories.title: Cyclone-hit Prakasam villages still without power
stories.summary: Villagers travel to urban centres to charge phones at ₹10 per charge and struggle to get drinking water and generator fuel.
stories.why_it_matters: Ongoing relief shortfall in Andhra Pradesh.

stories.title: Hijack threat note found on Kolkata-Mumbai Air India flight
stories.summary: Passengers were deboarded and the aircraft was moved to an isolation bay.
stories.why_it_matters: A significant aviation security incident.

stories.title: Delhi SIR: BJP BLAs' deletion applications concentrated in Mustafabad
stories.summary: 796 Form 7 applications against Muslims, filed by 20 BJP BLAs, were concentrated on 25 polling booths. BJP says it did not direct the filings.
stories.why_it_matters: Raises questions about electoral roll integrity.

stories.title: Low pressure likely over Andaman Sea around Nov 13
stories.summary: Squally weather with gusts up to 60 kmph is likely over the Andaman Sea and Southeast Bay of Bengal on Nov 14-15.
stories.why_it_matters: Could affect the AP coast weather after the recent cyclone.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh weighs making father's name optional in official documents
stories.summary: A state consultation calls for child-friendly policy so children of single parents, divorced couples and orphans are not denied education, ID or welfare.
stories.why_it_matters: Possible policy change in your home state.

stories.title: Israel's new Knesset sworn in; Eisenkot gets first shot at forming government
stories.summary: Gadi Eisenkot, Netanyahu's main rival, has first chance to build a coalition. Bennett heckled caretaker PM Netanyahu at the opening session.
stories.why_it_matters: Netanyahu's hold on power is under real threat.

stories.title: Chinese university bought Nvidia H200 chips despite US ban
stories.summary: Records show a Chinese university acquired restricted H200 AI chips. It adds to scrutiny of export controls.
stories.why_it_matters: Ties into the Nvidia-China controversy hitting markets.

stories.title: US says three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident
stories.summary: The US Justice Department charged three men over a string of plots including an incident near the UK airbase used by US forces.
stories.why_it_matters: Escalation in Iran-linked threats against Western targets.

stories.title: Russia, Ukraine exchange strikes as Abu Dhabi talks continue
stories.summary: Strikes were reported on both sides and Baltic states issued drone alerts while US-mediated talks go on.
stories.why_it_matters: The war continues despite diplomacy.

stories.title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak passes 11,000 cases, 5,387 deaths
stories.summary: Authorities struggle to contain the country's largest outbreak due to delayed detection and conflict.
stories.why_it_matters: A major ongoing public health crisis.

stories.title: Violence in Bangladesh as Hasina supporters protest
stories.summary: Supporters of the ousted PM, who is in exile in India, demand her return.
stories.why_it_matters: Affects India-Bangladesh relations.

stories.title: US House blocks bid to impeach Hegseth for now
stories.summary: Democrats can try again next year.
stories.why_it_matters: US political signal after the midterms.

stories.title: Nvidia sell-off deepens ahead of Nov 17 earnings
stories.summary: Shares fell nearly 10% amid the leadership controversy, tech sell-offs and price-target cuts. Shareholders have sued Huang and the company, with about $420bn lost in two days.
stories.why_it_matters: A bellwether for the AI trade and global index sentiment.

stories.title: US AI sell-off: how exposed are Indian AI-linked stocks?
stories.summary: Explainer on data centre plays and IT services exposure to a global AI downturn.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant to the IT-heavy index funds in your SIPs.

stories.title: India bonds slip as US Treasury yields jump
stories.summary: Hotter US inflation and hawkish policy signals outweighed lower crude oil prices.
stories.why_it_matters: Higher US yields can reduce foreign appetite for Indian debt.

stories.title: Rupee edges up 7 paise to 93.70 per dollar
stories.summary: Supported by foreign inflows, easing crude and improving geopolitical sentiment. It is among Asia's best performers in FY27.
stories.why_it_matters: Currency and macro backdrop for Indian investors.

stories.title: CoreWeave jumps after Q3 beat
stories.summary: Revenue was $3.66bn versus $1.37bn a year earlier, with a $132.5bn backlog and raised 2026 guidance, despite debt concerns.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows AI infrastructure demand still strong amid doubts.

stories.title: Amex to restore reward points after deduction complaints
stories.summary: Cardholders reported losing thousands or lakhs of points, with some balances going negative. Amex confirmed restoration, though questions remain.
stories.why_it_matters: Useful if you hold credit cards in India.

stories.title: 8th Pay Commission: timeline for salary hike
stories.summary: The commission has until May 2027 to submit recommendations, with a possible 1 January 2026 effective date.
stories.why_it_matters: Broad policy story on government pay.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO targets up to $1.4 trillion valuation
stories.summary: The price is expected at $70-$78 per share, per the New York Times. Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell shares worth about $250M at the midpoint while retaining control.
stories.why_it_matters: One of the biggest IPOs ever, in the AI sector you're targeting.

stories.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent 'swarm' feature
stories.summary: Google rolled out Carbon to the public after a two-week preview with cybersecurity defenders. It claims it is its strongest model and competitive with Anthropic and OpenAI, aimed at multi-step tasks like software development.
stories.why_it_matters: A major frontier model launch with agentic capabilities.

stories.title: Anthropic launches Claude office tools: Sheets, Whiteboards, Data and Meetings
stories.summary: Claude gets spreadsheets, whiteboards, dashboards, and a Google Meet integration that drafts plans and tasks live.
stories.why_it_matters: Signals AI labs moving into enterprise workflows.

stories.title: OpenAI launches Businesses in ChatGPT with verified Business Agents
stories.summary: Beta lets companies claim profiles and track engagement. Verified agents for US e-commerce firms help with comparison shopping.
stories.why_it_matters: Agentic commerce is an emerging area for AI engineers.

stories.title: New York AI safety law takes effect
stories.summary: Major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic must register, disclose safety practices and report critical incidents or face fines.
stories.why_it_matters: Regulation shaping how AI companies operate.

stories.title: TSMC to invest up to $1bn each in Anthropic and OpenAI
stories.summary: The foundry approved investments of up to $1 billion in the two AI companies.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows chip supply and AI labs tightening ties.

stories.title: Grok Build coding agent exposed confidential data
stories.summary: A researcher found 35,000 Grok Build apps open to anyone, some belonging to SpaceXSI.
stories.why_it_matters: A cautionary tale for security in AI coding agents.

stories.title: OpenAI and Upwork research on AI's effect on freelance work
stories.summary: Demand is shifting, new skill combinations are emerging, and AI projects have larger budgets and more hours.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant to AI's effect on jobs and skills.

stories.title: Google unveils two new specialized TPUs
stories.summary: The chips target confidential model training and higher memory capacity.
stories.why_it_matters: Infrastructure shifts behind AI workloads.

stories.title: Google: technical debt causes 'agent distraction' in coding agents
stories.summary: Stale TODOs, obsolete bug references and outdated specs derail coding agents into unrequested side-quests.
stories.why_it_matters: Practical insight for working with AI coding agents.

stories.title: Walmart's multi-agent LLM batch forecasting across 4,700 stores
stories.summary: Uses MCP grounding and loop agents, cutting inference costs from $100k+ to $10k per month by moving from PTUs to pay-as-you-go.
stories.why_it_matters: A real production LLM architecture write-up.

stories.title: Pinterest and Intel extend gProfiler
stories.summary: The open-source continuous profiler gets extended for production visibility across internet-scale fleets.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant to backend performance engineering.

stories.title: Google Cloud spend caps reach GA
stories.summary: Caps pause new usage once a monthly budget is hit, and cover only the Gemini API, the Agent Platform, Cloud Run and Cloud Run functions. Overages during enforcement delays are still billed.
stories.why_it_matters: Useful for GCP users.

stories.title: Tracking Anthropic-discovered vulnerabilities
stories.summary: VulnCheck's November update tracks vulnerabilities discovered by Anthropic, with 388 points on Hacker News.
stories.why_it_matters: AI-driven vulnerability discovery affects security practice.

stories.title: Alleged spy plot targeting Jensen Huang raises questions about Nvidia's future
stories.summary: The affair allegations around Huang bring reputational risk, successor uncertainty and scrutiny from shareholders and officials. The controversy dominated Web Summit.
stories.why_it_matters: Governance shock at the central company of the AI boom.

stories.title: Kissht raises ₹832 Cr via preferential issue
stories.summary: OnEMI Technology Solutions completed the issue, adding 24 new investors.
stories.why_it_matters: Fintech funding news.

stories.title: ShareChat parent FY26 loss widens 79% to ₹1,978 Cr
stories.summary: Revenue inched past ₹1,000 Cr.
stories.why_it_matters: Indian startup financial health.

stories.title: GoKwik non-compete clause puts vested ESOPs at risk
stories.summary: ESOP liquidity and terms are a growing issue in Indian startups.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant when evaluating product-company offers.

stories.title: MI and PBKS complete Hardik Pandya-Arshdeep Singh swap
stories.summary: Hardik moves to PBKS for ₹18 crore, up from ₹16.35 crore, while Arshdeep joins MI at his existing ₹18 crore fee.
stories.why_it_matters: Major IPL 2027 trade.

stories.title: Ravindra, Conway named in NZ squad for India Tests
stories.summary: Conway, Ravindra and Blundell are recovering from injuries and aim to be fit for the first Test in Wellington.
stories.why_it_matters: Squad news for India's upcoming series.

stories.title: Pakistan lead Sri Lanka in Rawalpindi Test
stories.summary: Sri Lanka are 320 behind with seven wickets in hand after two days. The second Test was moved to Rawalpindi due to Lahore smog.
stories.why_it_matters: Ongoing international series.
